Without centre holes the shaft cannot be turned or ground between centres to achieve this tolerance, so the designer must add centre hole callouts on both ends.","recommended_correction":"Add centre hole specifications (e.g., per ISO 6411) at both ends of the shaft in the front view."},{"rule_id":"MC-003","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"02- M6 x 10 DEEP"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D10","page":1,"quote":"10±0.2"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D13","page":1,"quote":"-0.1"}],"comment":"Note N1 and dimension D10 define two M6 threaded holes 10 mm deep, and feature F3 with dimension D13 shows a shoulder, yet no thread run-out or undercut is specified where the threads meet the shoulder. This prevents full thread engagement and proper seating of mating fasteners, so the designer must add a thread relief groove or explicitly allow thread run-out.","recommended_correction":"Add a thread undercut or run-out detail at the shoulder for the M6 threaded holes."}]}
